evidence: Human PDAC cell lines (PANC-1, MIA PaCa-2, BxPC-3) were treated with X-rays and protons.
Immunogenic cell death was measured based on HMGB1 release.
We demonstrate that a clinically relevant X-ray hypofractionation regimen (3x8 Gy) induces immunogenic cell death and activates IFNB1 and proinflammatory cytokines.
